name: Radio Operation
description: A knowledge move. Call for help, intercept a signal, jam a frequency, or reach a distant station. It must be learned from a teacher, a manual, or hard experimentation before it can be rolled.

name: Computer Use
description: A knowledge move. Recover data, hack a system, control a machine, or read a drive. It must be learned from a teacher, a manual, or hard experimentation before it can be rolled.

name: Cybernetics Configuration
description: A knowledge move. Install, calibrate, maintain, or safely disable an implant. It must be learned from a teacher, a manual, or hard experimentation before it can be rolled.

name: Field Surgery
description: A knowledge move. Stabilize, remove a bullet, amputate, or install an implant in the field. It must be learned from a teacher, a manual, or hard experimentation before it can be rolled.

name: Vehicle Repair
description: A knowledge move. Fix, modify, or jury-rig a vehicle when ordinary repairs are not enough. It must be learned from a teacher, a manual, or hard experimentation before it can be rolled.

name: Occult Lore
description: A knowledge move. Identify a relic, a rite, a sign, or an eldritch weakness. It must be learned from a teacher, a manual, or hard experimentation before it can be rolled.

name: Demolitions
description: A knowledge move. Place, disarm, or improvise explosives and breaching charges. It must be learned from a teacher, a manual, or hard experimentation before it can be rolled.

name: Chemistry
description: A knowledge move. Make drugs, fuel, purification, poisons, and medicine from raw stock. It must be learned from a teacher, a manual, or hard experimentation before it can be rolled.
